DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内板をご覧ですね。今日は広い範囲を回られるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the information board. Are you planning to cover a wide area today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 運動不足なので少し歩きたいですが、二十分以内で入口へ戻れる道を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 運動不足なので少し歩きたいと伝え、二十分以内で入口へ戻る道を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have not been getting enough exercise and want a little walk, but am looking for a route back to the entrance within twenty minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a little walk because you lack exercise, and request a route returning to the entrance within twenty minutes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この図の池を回る道は、ゆっくり歩くと三十分ほどです。花壇まで行って戻るなら十五分ほどですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The pond loop takes about thirty minutes at a slow pace. Going to the flowerbed and back takes about fifteen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら花壇で折り返します。さっき雨が降りましたが、途中に滑りやすい坂はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十五分の花壇往復を選び、雨の後に滑りやすい坂がないか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will turn back at the flowerbed. It rained earlier; are there any slippery slopes along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the fifteen-minute flowerbed return walk and ask whether there are slippery slopes after rain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 花壇までの舗装路は平らです。ただ、木の下はぬれています。芝生へ入る近道は避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The paved path to the flowerbed is flat, but it is wet beneath the trees. Avoid the shortcut across the grass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 芝生の近道は使いません。花壇に着く前に休みたくなったら、どこに座れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 芝生の近道を避けると伝え、花壇より手前で座れる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not use the grass shortcut. If I want to rest before reaching the flowerbed, where can I sit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will avoid the grass shortcut and ask where to sit before the flowerbed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 途中の分かれ道の手前に屋根付きのベンチがあります。右へ曲がると別の出口なので、花壇へは左です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a roofed bench before the fork. Right leads to a different exit, so take left for the flowerbed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かれ道は左ですね。帰りに別の出口へ出ないよう、同じ道を引き返す目印も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 往路の分岐は左と確認し、別の出口へ出ないため復路の目印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Left at the fork. I also want a return landmark so I do not leave through another exit when retracing the path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm left at the outward fork and ask for a return landmark to avoid a different exit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻る時は、青い案内板が見えた所を右です。今いる入口は白い門なので、二つを覚えておくとよいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: On return, turn right where you see the blue information board. The current entrance has a white gate; remember both.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帰りは青い案内板で右へ曲がって白い門へ戻ります。疲れたら花壇まで行かず、屋根付きのベンチで折り返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 青い案内板で右、白い門へ戻る経路を復唱し、疲れたら手前のベンチで折り返すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: On return, right at the blue board and back to the white gate. If tired, I will turn back at the roofed bench before the flowerbed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat right at the blue board and back to the white gate, and decide to turn back at the earlier bench if tired. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ええ、歩く距離は途中で調整してください。足元に気をつけて、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, adjust your distance along the way. Watch your footing and enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの便をお探しですか。こちらの案内板は、この乗り場から出るバスのものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which service are you looking for? This board is for buses leaving this stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が送ってくれた乗換案内には「中央広場」とあります。同じ名前が二つあるのですが、どちらで降りればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 中央広場という同名の停留所のどちらで降りるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend's transfer directions say Central Plaza. There are two stops with the same name; which should I get off at?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which of two stops named Central Plaza to get off at. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停留所名だけでなく、進行方向も見ましょう。その案内には何方面と書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Check the direction as well as the stop name. Which direction do those instructions say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「展示館方面」です。私は反対の「車庫方面」の欄を見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 展示館方面が目的で反対の車庫方面を見ていたと気づいて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Toward the Exhibition Hall. I was looking at the opposite, toward the Depot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you realized you need the Exhibition Hall direction but were looking toward the Depot instead. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 展示館方面なら、こちらの欄です。中央広場で乗り換える次の便はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: For the Exhibition Hall, use this column. Do you know the next service when changing at Central Plaza?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次は五番のバスです。中央広場で降りた場所から、そのまま五番に乗れるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 次は五番と示して降車場所と乗換乗り場が同じか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Bus number five. Can I board number five right where I get off at Central Plaza?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the next bus as number five and check whether the alighting point and transfer stop are the same. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この乗換図では、降車場所から横断歩道を渡った側に五番の乗り場があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: This transfer map shows number five's stop across the pedestrian crossing from where you get off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 横断歩道を渡る時間も必要なのですね。乗換時間が三分しかない案内なので、次の便に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 横断時間を考慮して三分の乗換を避け次の便に変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: So crossing time is needed too. The directions allow only three minutes, so I want to change to the next service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Allow crossing time and say you want the later service rather than a three-minute transfer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 急いで渡らず、余裕を取ったほうがよいですね。こちらに次の五番の便を含めた案内を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Better to allow time rather than rush across. I will provide directions including the next number five service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次の便を使う案内をもらいます。降りる前に展示館方面の中央広場か、車内の表示でも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 余裕のある案内を受け取り降車前に方向と停留所名も確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the later-service directions. Before getting off, I will also check the onboard display for Central Plaza toward the Exhibition Hall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept directions with more time and say you will check direction and stop name before alighting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 乗換図と新しい案内はこちらです。横断時もお気をつけて、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the transfer map and new directions. Take care crossing, and have a pleasant journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請する証明書は、ご本人の分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the certificate you are applying for your own?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 妹の分を頼まれて来ました。この用紙の申請者欄には、妹の名前を書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 妹の代理で来たと説明し申請者欄の記入を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My younger sister asked me to come for hers. Should I write her name in the applicant field?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you came for your younger sister and ask how to fill the applicant field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族でも、ご本人が来られた場合とは確認の仕方が違います。妹さんから預かった書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even for family, checks differ from the person coming themselves. Do you have documents entrusted by your sister?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 用件を書いたメモだけです。妹が自分で書いた申請書だと思っていましたが、白紙の用紙でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 預かったのはメモと白紙の用紙だけだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only a note of the request. I thought the form was one she had completed, but it was blank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only received a note and a blank form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: このまま妹さんの代わりに署名することはせず、代理の方の申請案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not sign for your sister as things stand; check the representative-application guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 妹の名前を勝手に署名しないようにします。代理申請の案内は紙でもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 妹の代筆署名をせず代理申請の紙の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not sign her name without authorization. May I have paper guidance for representative applications?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not sign for your sister and request paper guidance for proxy applications. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらをお渡しします。必要な書類は証明書の種類や請求の事情も確認してご案内します。証明書名はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here it is. Required documents depend on certificate type and circumstances too. Do you know the certificate's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 妹のメモには種類が書かれていません。提出先の案内を妹から送ってもらってから、必要書類を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 証明書の種類が不明なため妹から提出先の指定を送ってもらうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Her note does not say the type. I want her to send the submission destination's instructions before consulting about required documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the certificate type is unknown, so you will ask your sister to send the destination's requirements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、本日は申請を進めず、案内を受け取るところまでにしましょう。お預かりしたメモはお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we will not proceed with an application today; just receive guidance. I will return the note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモと白紙の用紙を持ち帰ります。妹に提出先の指定と代理申請の案内を見てもらい、準備してから来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メモと用紙を持ち帰り妹と案内を確認して準備後に再訪すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the note and blank form home. I will have my sister check the destination requirements and proxy guidance, then return prepared.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to take home the note and form, check guidance with your sister, and return after preparation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 書類がそろうか不明な点は、来庁前にもお問い合わせください。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: If unsure whether documents are complete, ask before visiting too. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票のこの二つの欄で迷われていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are these two questionnaire fields confusing you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「食欲」と「吐き気」の違いがわかりません。どちらも食べられないことですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食欲と吐き気の意味の違いを質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not understand the difference between appetite and nausea. Do both mean being unable to eat?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the difference in meaning between appetite and nausea. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食欲は食べたい気持ちで、吐き気は吐きそうな感じです。今はどのような状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Appetite means wanting to eat; nausea is feeling you might vomit. What is your condition now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 吐きそうではありませんが、食べたい気持ちがなく、昨日の夕食は半分残しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 吐き気はなく食欲が落ちて夕食を半分残したと区別して説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not feel like vomiting, but have no desire to eat and left half my dinner yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish no nausea from reduced appetite, and explain leaving half your dinner. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いがわかるように書きましょう。今日は食事や水分を取れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's write that distinction clearly. Have you eaten and drunk today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 朝はパンを一口だけ食べ、水はコップ一杯飲みました。量も問診票に書いたほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 朝に食べたパンと水の量を示し記入が必要か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: This morning I ate one bite of bread and drank a glass of water. Should I write the amounts too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the morning bread and water amounts and ask whether they should be entered. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、食べた量と飲んだ量を分けて書いてください。診察でも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, write food and drink amounts separately. We will check during the examination too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「朝食はパン一口、水一杯」と書きます。原因が胃の病気なのか、ここで教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飲食量の書き方を示し胃の病気か受付段階で判断できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write 'breakfast: one bite of bread, one glass of water.' Can you tell me here whether a stomach illness is the cause?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show how you will record intake and ask whether reception can judge if it is a stomach illness. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この段階では原因を判断できません。診察で医師にお尋ねください。記入のお手伝いならできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We cannot judge the cause at this stage. Ask the doctor during the examination. I can help with filling it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 病名を自分で書かず、食欲がないことと飲食した量を記入して診察で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 病名を推測せず食欲低下と飲食量を診察で伝えると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not write a disease name myself; I will enter low appetite and intake amounts, and explain during the examination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to guess a diagnosis but tell the doctor reduced appetite and intake amounts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記入できたらこちらへお出しください。待つ間につらさが増したらお知らせくださいね。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Hand it here when completed. Tell us if you feel worse while waiting. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の内容を伺います。今、誰かに追いかけられたり、直接会うよう迫られたりしていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please explain your concern. Is anyone chasing you or pressuring you to meet directly now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そのようなことはありません。ただ、配達の連絡だと思った画面に住所を入れてしまい、不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 直接の危険はないが配達案内の画面に住所を入力したと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nothing like that. But I entered my address on a screen I thought was a delivery notice, and am worried.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say there is no direct danger, but you entered your address on a supposed delivery screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつ、どのように画面を開きましたか。覚えている範囲でお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: When and how did you open the screen? Tell us what you remember.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝九時ごろ、携帯に届いた短いメッセージのリンクを開きました。荷物の再配達だと書かれていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今朝九時ごろ短いメッセージのリンクを開いた経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around nine this morning I opened a link in a short message on my phone. It said parcel redelivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain opening the short-message link around nine this morning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入力したのは住所だけですか。カード番号や暗証番号なども入力しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Was it only your address? Did you also enter a card number or PIN?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前と住所と電話番号です。カード番号は求められましたが、その前に画面を閉じました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 氏名住所電話番号は入力したがカード情報は入れず閉じたと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My name, address, and phone number. It requested a card number, but I closed it before that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Clearly state that name, address, and phone were entered, but no card information before closing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容を整理して確認します。元のメッセージは残っていますか。もう一度リンクを開く必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will organize and check the information. Do you have the original message? You need not open the link again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 元のメッセージはあります。画面を開き直さず、届いた時刻と入力した情報をメモして見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元のメッセージを残しリンクを再度開かず時刻と入力情報をメモで示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have it. Without reopening the screen, I will note the receipt time and information entered and show you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the original message, do not reopen the link, and show a note of the time and entered information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。相談として伺いますが、これだけで犯罪の有無や被害が出ないことを断定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. We will hear this as a consultation, but this alone cannot establish whether a crime occurred or guarantee no harm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 被害がないと決まったわけではないのですね。同じ相手から電話が来た場合の対応も、担当の方に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 被害の有無は未確定と理解し追加の電話への対応も担当者に相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: So no harm is not confirmed. I also want to consult the responsible staff about what to do if that party calls.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Understand harm remains undetermined and say you want to consult staff about further phone calls. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 入力内容のメモをお持ちのまま、こちらで担当者をお待ちください。続けて詳しい状況を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Wait here for the staff with your entered-information note. We will continue asking detailed circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 持ち上げた際に底がたわんでいますね。箱の中は重い物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: The bottom bends when lifted. Are the contents heavy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 辞書と本を家族に送ります。前に使った箱なので、このまま預けてよいか見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本を入れた再利用の箱をこのまま預けられるか状態確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Dictionaries and books for my family. It is a reused box, so please check whether I can hand it over as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a condition check of a reused book-filled box to see whether it can be accepted as it is. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 底の一部がはがれているので、今の状態ではお預かりできません。別の箱に詰め直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Part of the bottom is coming apart, so we cannot accept it in this condition. Can you repack into another box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家に小さな箱が二つあります。本を半分ずつ入れて、二個口で送ることもできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小箱二つに本を分けて二個で送れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have two small boxes at home. Can I divide the books equally and send two parcels?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether books can be divided into two small boxes and sent as two parcels. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの箱で大きさと重さを確認し、別々に受け付ける方法があります。送料も箱ごとにかかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can check each box's size and weight and accept them separately. Shipping is charged for each box too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱ごとに送料がかかるのですね。大きな箱を一つ買う場合と、どちらが安いか今わかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱ごとに送料がかかると理解し大箱一つとの費用比較を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So each box has shipping charges. Can you tell now which is cheaper compared with buying one large box?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Understand shipping is charged per box and request a cost comparison with one large box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 詰めた後の寸法と重さが必要なので、今は正確に比べられません。販売している箱の価格表はお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We need packed dimensions and weights, so cannot compare accurately now. I can give you our box price list.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 価格表をください。家で二つに分けた重さも量ってから決めます。隙間は新聞紙で埋めてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱の価格表を求め自宅で計量することと隙間の梱包材を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please give me the list. I will weigh the two divided boxes at home before deciding. Can I fill gaps with newspaper?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a box price list, say you will weigh at home, and ask about filling gaps with packing material. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新聞紙で隙間を埋める方法もあります。本が動かないように包み、箱の底も丈夫な状態にしてください。梱包材の案内もこちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Newspaper is one way to fill gaps. Wrap books so they do not move and ensure a sturdy bottom. Packing-material guidance is here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は箱を持ち帰って詰め直します。二箱の寸法と重さを控えて、送料を確認してから発送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日は持ち帰り詰め直して寸法と重さを準備し送料確認後に発送すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the box home and repack today. I will note both boxes' dimensions and weights and ship after checking postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take it home, repack and prepare dimensions and weights, then ship after checking charges. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 荷物はまだ受け付けていませんので、そのままお持ち帰りください。案内二枚もお忘れなく。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: The parcel has not been accepted yet, so take it home as it is. Do not forget both guidance sheets. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の操作についてのご相談ですね。どの段階で止まりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You need advice on a transfer operation. At which stage did it stop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 送金を確定した直後に通信が切れました。完了画面が出なかったので、もう一度送ろうか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 確定直後の通信切断で完了が不明なため再送金すべきか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The connection cut immediately after I confirmed sending. No completion screen appeared, so I am unsure whether to send again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to transfer again because disconnection just after confirmation left completion unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 重複する可能性があるので、確認するまで同じ振込を繰り返さないでください。受付番号の記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: It could duplicate, so do not repeat the same transfer until checked. Do you have a reference-number record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 画面は保存できませんでしたが、受付番号の入った通知が一通届いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面保存はないが受付番号付きの通知があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I could not save the screen, but received one notification containing a reference number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the screen was not saved but a reference-number notification exists. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その番号で状況を調べます。振込の金額と操作した時刻をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check using that number. Tell me the amount and operation time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金額は三万二千円で、十分ほど前です。請求書も持ってきたので照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三万二千円と十分前の操作を伝え請求書の照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thirty-two thousand yen, about ten minutes ago. I brought the invoice too; please compare it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State thirty-two thousand yen and ten minutes ago, and request comparison with the invoice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号と内容を担当に照会します。すぐに結果が出ない場合もあるため、お待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will ask the responsible staff about the number and details. The result may not be immediate; can you wait?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待ちます。相手に今すぐもう一度払うよう言われても、確認結果が出るまで追加で振り込まないほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 照会を待つと伝え相手に催促されても追加送金を控えるべきか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait. Even if they demand I pay again immediately, I should avoid another transfer until the result, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will await the inquiry and check whether to avoid another transfer even under pressure from the recipient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、重複を避けるため状況を確認しましょう。こちらでは現時点で着金まで断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, check the status to avoid duplication. We cannot establish arrival of funds at this point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相手には銀行で照会中だと連絡します。通知を消さず、結果を聞いてから次の操作を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手には照会中と連絡し通知を残して結果後に次の操作を判断すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them the bank is checking. I will keep the notification and decide the next operation after the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to tell the recipient it is being checked, retain the notification, and choose the next operation after the result. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受付番号を確認しますので、この窓口でお待ちください。通知の画面はそのまま保管をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will verify the reference number; wait at this counter. Keep the notification screen as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計は千九百円です。こちらの割引券をお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your total is one thousand nine hundred yen. Will you use this discount coupon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 使いたいです。百円引きと書いてありますが、この買い物で使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 百円割引券を千九百円の買い物に使えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to. It says one hundred yen off; can I use it for this purchase?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a one-hundred-yen coupon can be used on a one-thousand-nine-hundred-yen purchase. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 下の条件では、商品代金が二千円以上の場合に使える券です。今回は百円足りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The conditions below require goods totaling at least two thousand yen. This purchase is one hundred yen short.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、あそこの二百円のお菓子を足せば使えますね。追加すると支払いはいくらになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二百円のお菓子を追加した場合の割引後の支払額を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then adding that two-hundred-yen snack would qualify. How much would I pay after adding it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the discounted payment amount if adding a two-hundred-yen snack. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品代金が二千百円になり、券で百円引くと二千円です。袋が必要なら別に五円かかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Goods would total two thousand one hundred yen; subtracting one hundred with the coupon makes two thousand. A bag costs another five yen if needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今のまま買うより百円多くなりますね。お菓子は必要ないので追加せず、券は次に使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不要な買い足しで百円支払いが増えるため追加せず券を次回に回すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: That is one hundred yen more than buying as I am. I do not need the snack, so will not add it and will use the coupon next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide not to add an unneeded item that increases payment by one hundred yen, and save the coupon for next time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追加なしで千九百円ですね。袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: No addition, so one thousand nine hundred yen. Have you brought a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つ持っていますが、入り切らないので五円の袋を一枚ください。重い缶詰は自分の袋に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参袋に缶詰を入れ不足分として五円の袋を一枚買う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: One, but everything will not fit, so please sell me one five-yen bag. I will put the heavy cans in my own bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Put cans in your own bag and buy one five-yen bag for the rest. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋一枚を加えて千九百五円です。支払いは現金でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: With one bag, one thousand nine hundred five yen. Will you pay cash?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現金で千九百五円ちょうど払います。割引券も返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 千九百五円を現金でちょうど払い割引券の返却を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will pay exactly one thousand nine hundred five yen in cash. Please return the coupon too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pay exactly one thousand nine hundred five yen in cash and request the coupon back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ちょうどお預かりしました。券とレシートをお返しします。お買い上げありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Exact payment received. Here are your coupon and receipt. Thank you for shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遊具へ向かう道はこちらですが、今日は広場で練習の音が聞こえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: This way leads to the play equipment, but today there is practice noise from the plaza.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもがベビーカーで寝ているので、静かな場所を少し歩きたいです。広場を通らない道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 眠る子どものため広場の音を避ける散歩道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child is sleeping in the stroller, so I want a short walk somewhere quiet. Is there a path avoiding the plaza?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a walking path avoiding plaza noise for your sleeping child. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 花の通路なら広場から離れています。入口に段差がありますが、横のスロープをご利用いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The flower walkway is away from the plaza. There is a step at its entrance, but a ramp beside it is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: スロープを使います。案内図の細い道から入ると近そうですが、ベビーカーでも通れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: スロープを選び近道をベビーカーで通れるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will use the ramp. The narrow path on the map looks like a shortcut; can a stroller go through?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the ramp and check whether the stroller can use the shortcut. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その近道には狭い車止めがあります。無理に通さず、こちらの広い入口からお入りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The shortcut has narrow vehicle barriers. Do not force through; enter by this wide entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 車止めの隙間を通すのはやめます。ベビーカーを畳まずに行ける広い入口から回ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 狭い車止めを避けベビーカーを畳まず広い入口から入ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not try to squeeze between the barriers. I will go around through the wide entrance without folding the stroller.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid narrow barriers and decide to enter through the wide entrance without folding the stroller. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 花の通路の先には休憩所があります。ただ、今日は清掃中で中には入れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a rest area beyond the flower walkway, but it is being cleaned today and cannot be entered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 休憩所が使えないなら、そこで引き返します。外で腰を下ろせるベンチは途中にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 清掃中の休憩所では引き返し途中の屋外ベンチを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it cannot be used, I will turn back there. Are there outdoor benches along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Turn back at the rest area under cleaning and ask about outdoor benches on the way. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路の右側にベンチがあります。ベビーカーは通行の妨げにならない脇の空間へ寄せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Benches are on the right of the walkway. Move the stroller to the space beside them so it does not obstruct passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ベンチではベビーカーを脇へ寄せて休み、帰りも車止めを避けて広い入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ベビーカーを脇へ寄せて休み帰りも広い入口を使うと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will rest at the bench with the stroller to the side, then avoid barriers on return and use the wide entrance again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm resting with the stroller to the side and using the wide entrance on return too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 清掃中の場所には入らず、どうぞゆっくりお過ごしください。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Do not enter areas under cleaning, and enjoy a leisurely time. Take care returning too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お待ちのバスについてですか。現在、到着が遅れている便があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the bus you are waiting for? Some services are arriving late now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人を迎えに行く約束があるのですが、十時発のバスはもう出ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人を迎えに行く予定があると説明し、十時発のバスが出発済みか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I promised to pick up my friend. Has the ten o'clock bus already left?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain plans to meet your friend and ask whether the ten o'clock bus has departed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その便はまだ来ていません。到着見込みも出ていないため、何分遅れるとはお伝えできない状況です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: It has not arrived yet. No estimated arrival is available, so we cannot tell you how many minutes late.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ来ていないのですね。友人には十時半に会うと言ってしまいました。別の便なら間に合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予定のバスが未到着だと確認し、十時半の待合せに別の便なら間に合うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is not here yet. I told my friend we would meet at ten thirty. Can another bus get me there on time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the planned bus has not arrived and ask whether another service can meet the ten-thirty appointment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の便も同じ道路の混雑を受けています。今の情報だけで十時半に着ける便はご案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Other buses face the same road congestion. Current information does not let us suggest a service arriving by ten thirty.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら、友人には待ち合わせ場所から動かずに待ってもらって、私が乗れた時点で連絡します。ここで電話しても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人には場所を動かず待ってもらい乗車後に連絡すると決め、ここで電話してよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will ask my friend to stay at the meeting place and contact them once I have boarded. May I call here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to ask your friend to stay put and contact them after boarding, and ask permission to call here. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路を空けて、窓際の待合席でお願いします。放送が入るので、電話中も乗り場の表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep the passage clear and use the waiting seats by the window. Announcements will occur, so check platform displays during the call too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 窓際へ移ります。バスが着いたら表示は『到着』に変わりますか。それとも放送だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓際に移ると答え、バス到着時は表示が変わるのか放送だけか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will move by the window. When the bus arrives, does the display change to 'arrived,' or is there only an announcement?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will move by the window and ask whether arrival changes the display or only triggers an announcement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 係員が到着を確認してから、乗り場番号を表示し、放送もします。表示が出る前に道路側で待つ必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: After staff confirm arrival, we display the boarding-bay number and announce it. You need not wait by the road before the display appears.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。表示が出るまでは席で待ち、友人には今のうちに予定変更を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示が出るまで席で待ち、友人に予定変更を伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will wait seated until the display appears and tell my friend the changed plan now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait seated for the display and tell your friend about the changed plan. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、乗り場が決まりましたらご案内します。電話のあとも待合席でお待ちください。どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we will advise you when the bay is decided. Remain in the waiting seats after calling too. Take care.
